note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Three contests, all in the Coalisland area: Mountjoy, Meenagh and Coalisland; 'All 13 retiring Unionist members and five Nationalists are returned unopposed' (Northern Whig, 21 May 1958, p. 9). Council-meeting method: division inferred from the 2 June 1955 return (Bush: Cecil J. Burrowes, recorded by the same method); the Belfast Telegraph, 12 June 1958, p. 1 names him as re-elected vice-chairman at the first meeting of the new council. Returned unopposed.
